name: @chewygumxx/skill-writing-usage-specs
description: Writes and checks usage specs, the KDL describing a CLI's commands, arguments and flags, and generates completions, docs and clients from them. Use when writing, reviewing or debugging a usage spec, whether a .usage.kdl file, the #USAGE comments of a script run by a usage shebang, or a mise task's usage field; or when generating shell completions, Markdown, man pages, SDKs or a breaking-change check from one with the usage CLI.
